content.text: As a future move (after fixing this problem), we could actually construct RDF responses for non-20x responses. There would be some real work in that: what RDF vocabularies to use, whether such a functionality should be packed into the API spec, etc.
There is a lot of refactoring here with limited tests to verify continuity of functionality. I will test more thoroughly after this first round of code review comments have been addressed.
I decided to move forward with a new pull request with the simplified solution.
Nicely done. Thank you. We can move this forward pending response to code review comments.

renderedFields.description:
Issue: The content types for errors do not match the format of the body returned.

Expected: Content types match the media type of the returned representation

Steps to Reproduce:

  • Spin up empty 4.5 repo.
  • curl http://localhost:8080/rest/fcr:accessroles

Response received:
Status: 400, with Content-Type: text/turtle
Content-Length: 34
Body: Prefix fcr has not been registered

Which is text/plain, not text/turtle.

  • curl -I http://localhost:8080/rest/fcr:accessroles (HEAD not GET)

Status: 400, with ContentType: text/html
Content-Length: 308

Which is completely unrelated to what happens when you do a GET.
